camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public ListPartitions --region cn-hangzhou --TableId 'maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name' --Order Asc --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy CreateTime --Name 'ds=20250101'
description_en: Queries the partition list of a specified table in DataWorks Data Map. Currently supports MaxCompute and HMS (EMR cluster) types
description_zh: 查询数据地图给定数据表的分区列表，当前支持maxcompute和hms（EMR集群）类型
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-partitions --table-id maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name --name ds=20250101 --sort-by CreateTime --order Asc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPartitions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the table. You can obtain this value from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html
parameters.help_zh:
所属数据表ID，可参考ListTables接口返回结果，
以及https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en: The partition name. Fuzzy match is supported. This parameter is valid only for MaxCompute tables
parameters.help_zh: 分区名称，模糊匹配，该参数仅对maxcompute类型有效
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Default value: CreateTime. Valid values:


CreateTime: the creation time. Only MaxCompute tables are supported.
ModifyTime: the modification time. Only MaxCompute tables are supported.
Name: the name. This is the sort method used for HMS tables.
RecordCount: the number of records. Only MaxCompute tables are supported.
DataSize: the storage size. Only MaxCompute tables are supported
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认为CreateTime，枚举值，当前支持


CreateTime：创建时间，仅MaxCompute类型支持。
ModifyTime：修改时间，仅MaxCompute类型支持。
Name：名称，HMS类型使用的排序方式。
RecordCount：记录数，仅MaxCompute类型支持。
DataSize：存储量，仅MaxCompute类型支持
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. Default value: Asc. Valid values:


Asc: ascending order.
Desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向，默认为Asc，枚举值，当前支持


Asc：升序。
Desc：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认为10，最大为100
parameters.name: page_size
